title: Script GC begin mark
summary: Recover the 0x4f20e0 thiscall phase initialization, conditional marking, root scan and final phase update.
test_description: Compare complete fixtures with the original across signed tag boundaries, mark bits, aliasing, and nine optional roots; verify helper side effects, untouched bytes, skipped null values, and FS head restoration. Both integration adapters call the accepted original helpers.

Layouts and pointers describe the 32-bit original; all pointers accessed on a taken path must be valid. Helper implementations remain external dependencies.
